segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, yeah, thanks for making time. I had us down for thirty minutes to confirm the calibration program scope and, if it still looks right, talk through dates for the pilot.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that works. We’ve got 1,840 instruments in the main plant, plus maybe 260 in the service depot. I don’t want to buy for the depot until we know the labels and recall notices work for our team.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. So for the pilot we’d set up the main plant only: 12 full users, 38 technician logins, and read-only access for QA managers. The pricing sheet puts that at $28,400 for the first year, including the import and two remote training sessions.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. The seat count sounds right. On invoicing, can you split it so software is one line and the import service is another? Our controller asked for that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, we can do that on the order form. Same total, just two lines: $22,800 for the subscription and $5,600 for implementation. Payment terms would be net 30 unless you need something different.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Net 30 is fine. We’re trying to go live by April 15 because the auditors come in May. Is that realistic if we sign by March 8?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, that’s realistic. If we have signature by March 8, we can kick off March 12, get your asset file loaded that week, and use the last week of March for technician training. April 15 gives a little cushion.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. One thing: we need calibration certificates stored for seven years. Is that included, or is there an archive fee?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Included. The standard plan includes certificate storage and retrieval for the full subscription period, and the retention setting can be set to seven years. No separate archive fee.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Alright. Send the order form with the 12 full users, 38 techs, main plant only, one-year term starting March 12. I’ll route it to procurement this afternoon.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll send it over in the next hour with the two invoice lines and the April 15 target go-live noted. If procurement has redlines, just send them back to me and we’ll work through them.
